summary: Tested DocGalaxy admin dashboard new features (iter 12): serial number column, delete-with-confirm, real-time new-order notification bell/badge, and regression (payment toggle, search, view/bookmarklet, reviews tab). Backend pytest suite (4 tests) all passed. Frontend Playwright flow fully passed end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js is approaching ~420 lines with multiple sub-components (BookmarkletLink, OrderDetailDialog) — consider splitting into separate files for maintainability.

loadOrders polling uses a seenRef baseline initialized from first fetch; if first fetch fails (network blip) it would init to null and subsequent fetches would all be treated as 'fresh'. Low risk but worth guarding.
No pagination on /api/admin/orders (hard limit 2000). Fine for now but will need pagination at scale.

seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ prefixed orders via API during tests; one UI-flow order was deleted at end; a few other TEST_ customers/orders may remain and can be filtered by purchased_by starting with 'TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Serial column renders idx+1 (data-testid order-serial-<id>), confirmed re-sequencing after filter. Delete dialog uses shadcn AlertDialog with testids delete-order-<id>, delete-confirm-<id>, delete-cancel-<id>, delete-confirm-btn-<id>. Notification polling interval is 15s in AdminDashboard.loadOrders. Baseline (no badge) → create+submit new order via customer API → within ~17s notification-badge appears with count '1' and toast; clicking notification-bell clears badge. Backend DELETE /api/admin/orders/{id} returns 401 (no auth), 403 (customer token), 404 (missing id), 200 with {order_id} on success.
